lede: The most consequential meeting this week is Monday's Open Space Commission, where three competing trail alignments for Valley Floor Reach 1 are on the table — routes that thread around wetland delineations and will shape how people move through that land for a long time. The Telluride Mountain Club is also asking permission to route a quarter-mile of long-planned trail through open space, which is the kind of incremental decision that adds up. Mid-week, the Planning Commission and BOCC sit down together Thursday to work through Land Use Code amendments touching forestry, oil and gas, deep geothermal, and condominium plats — no final votes, but this is where the language gets written.

notable.stake: Three Valley Floor trail routes up for review; wetlands and access hang in the balance.
Land Use Code rewrites on forestry, oil, gas, geothermal, and condo plats take shape here.
